text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Thursday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The U.N. Secretary General Kofi Annan has proposed that the U.N.s mission in Angola be extended for two weeks after its current mandate expires on March 31.
- U.S. special representative to the Angolan peace process, Paul Hare, will be in Luanda for the next few days on an official mission.
- The National Assembly has decided to delay debate on the special status of UNITA leader Jonas Savimbi until April. It said necessary documents were not yet ready for the debate to happen.
